method: Read-only catalog and bounded September 28–October 2 cron/API audit SELECTs. No cron or API invocation.

queries.jobsAndRuns: WITH selected_jobs AS (SELECT jobid, jobname, schedule, active, position('update-goalie-projections-v2' in command) > 0 AS references_goalie_v2, md5(command) AS command_hash FROM cron.job WHERE jobname::text ILIKE '%goalie%projection%' OR position('update-goalie-projections-v2' in command) > 0), selected_runs AS (SELECT r.jobid, r.runid, r.status, r.start_time, r.end_time FROM cron.job_run_details r JOIN selected_jobs j USING (jobid) WHERE r.start_time >= '2026-09-28T00:00:00Z' AND r.start_time < '2026-10-03T00:00:00Z' ORDER BY r.start_time DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT jsonb_build_object('jobs', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(j)) FROM selected_jobs j), '[]'::jsonb), 'runs', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)) FROM selected_runs r), '[]'::jsonb)) AS evidence;
queries.apiAudits: SELECT job_name, run_time, status, rows_affected, details->>'method' AS method, details->>'statusCode' AS status_code, details->>'durationMs' AS duration_ms, details->>'rowsUpserted' AS audit_rows_upserted, details->>'failedRows' AS audit_failed_rows, jsonb_typeof(details->'response') AS response_type, details->'response' AS response_value, jsonb_typeof(details->'timing') AS timing_type, jsonb_typeof(details->'finalAudit') AS final_audit_type FROM public.cron_job_audit WHERE job_name = '/api/v1/db/update-goalie-projections-v2' AND run_time >= '2026-09-28T00:00:00Z' AND run_time < '2026-10-03T00:00:00Z' ORDER BY run_time DESC LIMIT 20;

limitations: Stored audit captures are not certified immutable; no historical code commit, deployment version, input revision or per-goalie run link is present in the inspected fields.
Cron SQL completion precedes the API receipt by seconds; succeeded means the scheduled command completed, not that downstream goalie writes succeeded.
API rows_affected and rowsUpserted are null. Recorded numeric counts come from parsed stored response.updates and response.observability.goalieRowsProcessed.
The same-minute October 1 API receipt and six captured goalie row timestamps are consistent, but not a proven row-to-run join or historical screenshot attribution.
The ownership decision version identifies a table ownership contract, not the deployed model or code version.
No October 2 run was returned by this bounded query. This observation does not establish a failed or pending run.
Initial selected-key discovery failed on JSON null finalAudit being a scalar; the successful query inspects types and parses the response string locally.
No task acceptance gate is closed by these receipts alone.
